$comment: Design gate levels per layer and destination. off = not run; report = runs, shows on the PR, never fails it; block = fails the check. 'nightly' runs on main's live preview, where block means the run turns red and GitHub notifies. Rules (test/design-gate.test.js): main is never looser than develop; a layer or page moves up only after 3 green runs in a row, or, for visual-figma, once its Figma baseline is approved. Change levels only in a reviewed PR. See .claude/skills/design-compliance/SKILL.md.

tokens.what: Figma tokens = CSS tokens; colour and font-size literals never grow; media rules re-lay-out the real grid

responsive.what: No sideways scroll, no clipped text, 24px tap targets, no stretched images, one h1, every page type at 390/768/1440

product.what: Cards and product pages match the product catalog: image, alt, price, link; galleries use approved images

specs.what: Measured block layout and style match the values taken from each block's Figma node

coverage.what: Every block and page type has a Figma source, or a recorded reason

visual-main.what: Before/after/diff screenshots against the base branch, attached to the report

visual-figma.what: Screenshot against the approved Figma frame export
